value.boundary: Discovery observes generated HTML bytes. Declared-reference means an exact selector/property has an inventory reference, not proof of correctness or descendant coverage. External CSS/scripts and inline bodies are opaque dependencies; link destinations are not crawled.

value.scope: Entire generated index.html and every IdentityTheme homeRoute, including head metadata, navigation, text, images, attributes, catalogue output and footer.
value.method: Algebra-owned lexical HTML scan with quote-aware tags and attributes; nonempty text and every non-id attribute are observed. Only exact element selector and property references are reconciled. No equality-based intent inference or ancestor/subtree coverage.
value.boundary: This scans the five generated homepage documents, not every corpus destination or live DOM state. Comments, doctype, formatting whitespace and id locator attributes are excluded. Inline script/style bodies and external script/stylesheet dependencies are opaque and remain undecided unless precisely declared. CSS internals, runtime-only states, shadow DOM, frames and semantic/visual fitness are not certified. Token ordinals are byte-rendering evidence addresses, not stable DOM paths.
